description: This file defines a React component named SlidePreview that renders a visual preview of a presentation slide. It computes page sizes, scales positional rectangles responsively, falls back to default placeholders if needed, and displays frame boxes with labels for each placeholder or field in the slide, including support for images and rotation.

methods.name: getPageSize(templateModel)
methods.description: Determines the page size in points from the template model, or defaults to preset dimensions.

methods.name: scaleRect(rect, page)
methods.description: Converts a rectangle's coordinates from points to percentages relative to the slide size for responsive rendering.

methods.name: fallbackBoxesForFields(fields)
methods.description: Creates default placeholder boxes arranged vertically when layout placeholders are absent.

ctags.name: SlidePreview
ctags.pattern: /^export default function SlidePreview({ slideStep, templateModel, formData }) {$/
